name: t7
title: Call of Duty: Black Ops III (T7)
note: Addresses from the decrypted BlackOps3.exe (runtime base 0x7ff625b80000), rewritten flat (raw offset = RVA). Primitives found 2026-09-26 by disassembly, starting from Load_Stream (0x14266f0, the call site acts' traces named at +0x13fe649) and DB_LoadXFile (0x13ef6f0, the only caller of stream_init).
rva_note: file_read(dst, n) copies zone bytes; file_string(dst) copies a C string and returns its length, NUL counted (Load_XString 0x1426800 advances the stream by it). Load_Stream(flag, dst, n) switches on the block: 0, 5, 6 read; 1, 2 memset; 3, 4 record (dst, n) for the delayed read after the last asset (0x14266a0); 7 and 8 read nothing. push(k) (9: the current block), pop rewinds the temp block 0. alloc(mask) aligns the cursor; insert_ptr reserves an 8-byte slot in block 5. resolve: *p = base[p >> 60] + (p - 1 & 2^60 - 1); resolve_deref the same, dereferenced.

asset_dispatch.note: the game's asset loop (DB_LoadXFile, 0x13f08c0): varXAsset = &list[i]; Load_XAsset(false). Load_XAsset reads nothing (flag 0) and hands &header to Load_XAssetHeader (0x140e260), an if-chain over the type calling each Load_<T>Ptr.

stream_note: a back reference is block << 60 | offset + 1. Blocks 3 and 4 (delayed) read nothing when loaded; their bytes follow the last asset, in the order the loads were made (0x14266a0).

release.note: set once the first full record exists

zone_load.note: the tail of DB_LoadXFile (0x13f07dd): stream_init, push(5), the 0x30-byte XAssetList file_read raw into its static; under push(5) the script strings (0x1406380); if depends: alloc(3), then the string array reader (0x140fea0) on dependCount; if assets: alloc(7), Load_Stream the array, then each entry dispatched with varXAsset = &list[i]; pop; the delayed reads (0x14266a0).
zone_load.add_asset_note: DB_AddXAsset(type, header) (0x141f4e0) and its wrappers (rcx = &slot; the struct readers' Ptr functions call them after loading into the temp block 0): the game copies the struct into its pool and points the slot at the copy. the zone format performs the copy; the wrappers run (the reach rule would skip them).

const_calls.note: an alignment helper (the max of several alignof values) the weapon reader calls before alloc(value - 1) (0x140d0e0); returns 8 when run alone

export.both_marker_assets_note: a SUB* row is an asset pointer (Load_<T>Ptr: the pointer tested == 0, then > -3 for the inline and resident markers): each of the 23 readers holding one resolves its back reference with resolve_deref (0x1426640; Load_MaterialPtr 0x1403110 at 0x1403187), so the reference names the slot that points at the asset, not the asset
